description: A generative sequencer that makes a new sequence every day from the date, with a step value, a step modulation, two rhythms and an end-of-sequence trigger

params.text: Sets how many steps of the generated sequence are played, 1 to 64
Advances the sequence by one step
Returns the sequence to its first step
Attenuates and inverts the step modulation output

inputs.text: A trigger advances the sequence by one step
A trigger returns the sequence to its first step

outputs.text: The main value of the current step, generally used as pitch
A second value for the current step, for velocity or a filter frequency, scaled and offset by its own knobs
Rhythmic triggers generated for the day, firing on the first beat except when the day's flavour is rANdoM
A second set of rhythmic triggers generated for the day
A trigger on the last step of the sequence

notes: the colour behind the date gives the day's flavour: magenta for rANdoM with no pattern, yellow for a 3 beat rhythm, green for 4 and orange for 5
the sequence moves only on a trigger at the step input or a press of the step button; there is no clock inside the module
a preset for this module is a locked seed, so the presets that ship with the plugin play the sequences of particular dates
menu: Lock Current Seed: keeps today's sequence instead of generating a new one tomorrow, and the locked seed is saved in the patch and in presets
Seed: shows the number today's sequence was generated from, and Flavour: the rhythm it was given
>>> Time Travel Forwards >>> and <<< Time Travel Backwards <<< move the date the sequence is generated from
